
Plot calibrated data for both depths through the whole season
```{r}
ggplot(par_df, aes(date_time, calibrated_value)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) + 
  facet_wrap(vars(depth_m)) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("Calibrated PAR ", par_df$lake_id)) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 15)
```

```{r}
ggplot(par_df, aes(date_time, raw_value)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21) + 
  facet_wrap(vars(depth_m)) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("RAW PAR ", par_df$lake_id)) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 15)
```
